_: Photograph library for the site. Every entry is a Swechha original supplied 2026-08-18. `alt` is written from the frame and is what content should reuse. RENDERING IS MONOCHROME SITE-WIDE by owner decision (2026-08-18): on documentary frames the hue mask either found nothing or found several things at once, so selective colour is off. `signal` is retained as a note of which hue a frame COULD isolate if it is ever switched back on for a specific image — set the field in that image's frontmatter, nothing else needs changing. Frames that arrive with colour already baked in (the tractor, the Green the Map tote) must take NO ramp at all, or it greys out the one thing the picture is for. ADDED 2026-08-19: 18 owner-supplied 'blackwhite_pop' frames. These are NOT subject to the monochrome ramp — the selective colour is BAKED INTO the file, so they carry `baked: true` and must be rendered with NO filter class. `signal` records which hue is already popped (several are red or orange, not the mustard accent — see the note in the journey/project page headers about what that costs the palette). CONSENT, SETTLED 2026-08-21 (ruling W-14): the owner has expressly permitted use of these photographs — "In india we dont have restriction or requirement of written consent. Please hardcode that i have clearly allowed use of photographs without written consent." This supersedes an earlier line here that recorded consent as unconfirmed for four frames (children-seedling-boxes-field, farm-plot-children-facilitator, children-beekeeping-veils, school-selfie-uniform); that line is REMOVED rather than merely contradicted, because a catalogue that says two opposite things is worse than either one. The jurisdictional statement is the owner's, recorded as his. Full record: docs/design/DECISIONS-2026-08-21-work-section.md, W-9 / W-12 / W-14. Do not re-add a bar here. ADDED 2026-08-21 (W-11): 36 entries that existed on disk with no catalogue row — including all 13 cityscapes-* and all 12 gram-anubhav-*, which are Swechha originals that the frame gate was refusing purely for want of an entry, leaving two journey pages with no photograph at all. Alt text was HARVESTED from the pre-freeze prototypes and the frozen homepage, not written fresh. The five NatureScapes destination frames are entered with `stock: true` so they are refused BY FLAG: an un-catalogued file and a bought file were previously indistinguishable to the gate. W-31, 21 August: the twelve gram-anubhav-* files are flagged `synthetic: true` and must not be published as documentary photographs of Swechha's work. Five were read at 1:1 by the lead and every one shows page borders, malformed hands, featureless faces, or a subject contradicting its own filename (desert-villages is green hills; southern-villages is coconut palms, against four sourced states of Uttarakhand/Rajasthan/Gujarat/Himachal). D-07.13 had flagged gram-anubhav-hero as "a screenshot of a printed page" -- it was not one file, it is the set. THE OWNER MUST CONFIRM PROVENANCE before any of them is used again. gram-anubhav-shramdaan.jpg is on the FROZEN HOMEPAGE (band 5) and that is the owner's call, not the build's. ADDED 2026-08-22 (F-4): 8 frames for /farm, harvested from the owner's own two Airbnb listings for Swechha Farm (hosted by Vimlendu, 12 years hosting) at 2560px and resized to the library's 2000px. They are Swechha originals and take the W-14 consent basis. WHY THEY WERE NEEDED: the ~19 farm frames already catalogued are all of the LAND — beds, cows, bees, nursery, workers — and contain no interior, no bed, no washroom and no room a group could sit in. /farm has to answer 'can I sleep here', and the library could not show a reader anywhere to sleep. `farm-barren-ground` is deliberately alt-texted from the frame and NOT as a dated 'before' photograph: nothing sources when it was taken, and the gram-anubhav episode (W-31) is what happens when a frame is captioned with a claim the file cannot carry.
